title: observability: automate Prometheus/Grafana/log-shipping for Private installs (Helm + Terraform modules)
author: Sofia Martinez
description: Context: Private (VPC/on-prem) installs currently require manual installation and configuration of the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, and log shipping). This PR automates provisioning and configuration via the private-installer: Helm charts (packaged and opinionated) plus Terraform modules for cluster-scoped setup. Motivation: reduce operator burden, provide reproducible dashboards/alerting for Private customers, enable one-click enablement from installer config. What this PR does: 1) Adds a new optional observability addon to the installer controlled by installer config (observability.enabled: true/false). 2) Adds opinionated Helm values and templates for kube-prometheus-stack (Prometheus Operator), Grafana provisioning (datasources + folder/dashboards), and Fluent Bit -> Loki log shipping (with an option for Elasticsearch). 3) Adds Terraform modules to provision cluster-scoped resources used by the stack (CRDs, namespace, default storageclass checks, RBAC bootstrap for charts) and example policies for restricted clusters. 4) Adds Grafana dashboards: Redwood - Inference Overview, Request Latency by Model, KV Cache hit/miss rates, Per-route token cost. Dashboards are provisioned via Grafana provisioning config so they come up on install. 5) Adds PrometheusRules with alerts for: Prometheus target down, high ingestion latency, scrape failures, high total token/sec, and sustained high tail-latency for generation endpoints. 6) Adds Helm values and installer flags to support air-gapped installs: bundle manifests for CRDs, skip remote image pulls (imageOverride), and toggle storage persistence to accommodate ephemeral clusters. 7) Adds upgrade and rollback notes: charts are pinned to patch versions; installer will attempt canary rollout of Prometheus/Grafana using Helm hooks and will mark observability addon as failed if post-install probes don't pass within timeout. 8) Adds automated acceptance tests: helm lint, terraform validate, e2e helm install on KinD with an optional airgap flow. Considerations / limitations: - Prometheus requires persistent storage; installer will fail (and provide an actionable message) if no storageClass is provided unless persistence is explicitly disabled. - Requires CRD installation privileges for operator CRDs; for highly restricted clusters, follow the 'operator-crd-only' terraform path included. - Grafana admin password is generated and stored as a Kubernetes secret; operator should rotate if desired. Rollout plan: deploy to staging private installs for two weeks, smoke verify dashboards and alert triggers, then enable in production private-installer images for new installs. Backwards compatibility: the observability addon is opt-in and disabled by default for existing customers. Security: secrets are written as Kubernetes secrets; we documented integration with customer KMS/HSM for sensitive clusters.
commits: 6 commits: Add helm charts and values for kube-prometheus-stack & grafana; Add grafana dashboard JSON + provisioning; Add fluent-bit->loki helm values + templates; Add terraform module 'observability-bootstrap' for CRDs/RBAC/storage checks; Add installer flag and docs; Add tests and CI pipeline updates.

release_notes: Adds optional observability addon for Private installs: automated Prometheus/Grafana provisioning, dashboards, alerting, and log shipping (Fluent Bit -> Loki/ES). Opt-in by default. See docs/private/observability.md for configuration and upgrade notes.
